coverageNotes: Does not demonstrate unrestricted scale in the number of distinct values or full backend implementation.

questions.question: Which expression finds the next distinct age?

options.rationale: Incorrect: gte includes the same age again; the progress guard rejects that repeated value.
Correct: gt excludes all rows at the previous age, and first selects the next age in index order.
Incorrect: eq stays within the age already returned; the progress guard rejects it.
Incorrect: lt looks below the current age. Starting at the smallest age makes it stop after one value.
